D/ ANTONINVS AVG PI VS PP TRP XVI ; R/ COS IIII

Silver coin. Denarius of Antoninus Pius (138-161), RIC vol. 3 page 53 no. 219, issue of 152-153. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, bearded. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS AVG PI VS PP TRP XVI. Reverse description: Figure helmeted and draped standing left with trident right and holding L-shaped object in right hand. Reverse inscription: COS IIII. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 2.36gms, die axis: 6
